verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe searching the global scholarly literature, including references and citations, with filters by author, journal, year and PDF availability, plus DOI and bibliography resolution and full-text PDF reading. Independent users report it surfaced papers they had missed in Google Scholar, arXiv, PubMed and ScienceDirect. missing for 10: documentation of which scholarly databases or corpora are indexed, and adequate coverage of gray literature, dissertations and theses (hands-on users report these were largely missed).
